name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All nine trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and training success in the last 10% of training was also 0. The changes covered three recipes (3 epochs, 1 epoch with high samples, and low gamma with low lr), three trunks (a CNN, layer tokens and a transformer) and three heads (footprint pooling, a learned 3x3 conv and multi-anchor pooling). A uniform zero across such different designs points to a shared assumption, not to capacity or recipe. Every head so far assumes that action index = type*Y*X + y*X + x and maps the logits spatially onto the grid. The task warns that the world may differ from its description. If the action layout or footprint geometry differs, for example cell-major order, transposed axes or reordered types, every spatial head is wrong. This round tests heads that assume no action geometry: a fully connected head to all actions, with the legality mask fed in through a learned linear layer, so the network can learn the real layout.
